readings.Aries: Your half-life in any comfortable situation is shorter than you'd like to admit. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Taurus: Your care for the physical world — spaces, objects, bodies — is a form of love. Extend it inward. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Gemini: You can do two things at once. This particular thing requires one. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Cancer: The past you return to had things in it that were real and good and also things that were not. Hold both. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Leo: Someone needs to hear what you think. Say it clearly and without hedging. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Virgo: There's a problem you're solving with effort that could be solved with a single honest conversation. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Libra: There is indecision, and then there is gathering information. Know which you're doing. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Scorpio: What's beneath the anger is more interesting than the anger. Go there. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Sagittarius: Your generosity of spirit is real and sometimes extended to people who don't respect it. Discern. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Capricorn: Your relationship to failure is more complex than others realise. It costs you more than it looks like. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Aquarius: Your idealism is not naïveté. It is a choice. Keep choosing it, but with your eyes open. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Pisces: The boundary between you and other people is more permeable than average. This is your gift and your difficulty. What worked before will not work the same way this time.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
